stem.text: An air bubble is rising through a liquid at a constant speed. The forces on it are the upthrust $U$, the viscous drag $D$ and its weight $W$.
Which diagram shows the directions and relative sizes of the forces?

A.alt: Circle with vertical arrows labelled U, D and W.

B.alt: Circle with vertical arrows labelled U, D and W.

C.alt: Circle with vertical arrows labelled U, D and W.
